items.title: 8.5 Podon mein pani ki naqal (transport) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.5, printed pages 184-187.

blocks.text: Jarein apni wasee shakhon se jazb ke liye bara satahi raqba (surface area) deti hain. Jar ke baal (root hairs), jar ke epidermal cells ki tawseeh, pani aur minerals lene ka zyada tar kaam karte hain. Mitti se pani aur minerals active aur passive transport se jar ke epidermal cells mein dakhil hote hain, cortex se guzarte hain aur jar ke markaz mein xylem tak pohnchte hain. Jar ke andar yeh teen mukhtalif raston se safar karte hain.

items: Apoplast rasta jar ki mutasil cell walls ke nizam se guzarne wala musalsal rasta hai. Endodermis par Casparian strips ki wajah se yeh toot jata hai.

Symplast raste mein pani aur minerals jar ke cells ke aapas mein jure protoplasts se guzarte hain, jo plasmodesmata se jure hain, yani cytoplasm ke dhaage jo mutasil cell walls ke surakhon se guzarte hain. Symplast rasta kam aham hai siwaye endodermis ke ilaqe mein minerals ke liye.

Vacuolar raste mein pani aur minerals cell membranes, cytoplasm, tonoplasts (vacuole ki jhilliyan) aur vacuoles ko paar karte hain, vacuole se vacuole tak jate hue, symplast aur apoplast ko chhor kar. Is raste se harkat na-honay ke barabar (negligible) hai.

blocks.alt: Baen ek root hair cell, vacuoles wale chaar cortex cells, ek endodermis cell jis ke pehluon par bhoori Casparian strips, aur daen xylem. Ek narangi lakeer cell walls ke saath chal kar Casparian strip par rukawat ke nishan ke saath ruk jati hai; ek jamni lakeer har cell ke cytoplasm se guzar kar xylem mein jati hai; ek neeli dashed lakeer vacuoles se guzarti hai.
blocks.caption: Jar ke paar apoplast, symplast aur vacuolar raste (Figure 8.7 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Pani root hair par dakhil hota hai aur teen raston se cortex paar kar ke xylem tak jata hai. Apoplast rasta cell walls ke saath chalta hai aur endodermis par pani-rok (waterproof) Casparian strip se ruk jata hai. Symplast rasta plasmodesmata ke zariye cytoplasm se cytoplasm tak jata hai aur yun endodermis paar karta hai. Vacuolar rasta jhilliyon aur tonoplasts ke paar vacuole se vacuole tak jata hai aur na-honay ke barabar miqdar le jata hai.

blocks.text: Xylem woh vascular tissue hai jo pani aur hal shuda minerals jaron se tane aur patton tak le jata hai; yeh ek aham banawati tissue bhi hai jo mechanical sahara deta hai. Yeh tracheids, vessels, xylem fibres aur xylem parenchyma par mushtamil hai. Tracheids lambe, patle cells hain jin ki moti lignin wali deewarein hain; un ke sire nokeele (tapered) hain aur yeh bordered pits se jure hain jo pani ko cells ke darmiyan pehlu se guzarne dete hain. Vessels chhote aur chaure hain, sira-ba-sira musalsal naliyon mein tarteeb diye gaye, jin ke siron par pani ki moassar harkat ke liye perforation plates hain. Xylem fibres moti lignin wali deewaron wale lambe cells hain, pakne par murda, jo xylem ki banawati mazbooti barhate hain. Xylem parenchyma cells zinda, patli-deewar wale cells hain jo pani aur nutrients rakhte hain, pehlu ki (lateral) naqal mein hissa lete hain aur xylem ke bharne aur dobara banne mein madad karte hain.

blocks.alt: Baen, chaar xylem cells: bordered pits wala lamba nokeela tracheid, perforation plates wale jure hue elements ka chaura vessel, ek gehra lignin wala fibre aur chhote zinda parenchyma cells. Daen, chaar phloem cells: nuqtedar sieve plates wale jure elements ki sieve tube, us ke pehlu mein chhoti lakeeron se jure companion cells, ek phloem fibre aur parenchyma.
blocks.caption: Xylem aur phloem ke cells (Figures 8.8 aur 8.10 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Xylem: tracheids lambe, patle, lignin wale cells hain jin ke nokeele sire aur pehlu ke bahao ke liye bordered pits hain; vessels chhote, chaure elements hain jo perforation plates ke zariye sira-ba-sira jure hain; fibres moti lignin wali deewarein rakhte hain aur murda hain, mazbooti dete hain; parenchyma cells zinda hain, pani aur nutrients rakhte aur unhen pehlu mein le jate hain. Phloem: sieve tube elements sieve plates ke zariye sira-ba-sira jur kar sieve tube banate hain; har ek ke saath plasmodesmata se jure companion cells hain jo ATP aur proteins dete hain; phloem fibres sahara dete hain, aur phloem parenchyma sugars, resins, latex aur mucilage rakhta hai.

blocks.text: Pani jaron se patton tak zyada tar xylem se jata hai. TACT mechanism (Transpiration, Adhesion, Cohesion, Tension) is baat ka aam taur par maana hua model hai ke pani kashish-e-saql (gravity) ke khilaf xylem se pode ke har hisse tak kaise jata hai; yeh pani ki tabee aur kimiyai khasoosiyat aur pode ke mahol se taalluq par munhasir hai.

items: Transpiration patton ki satah se, khaas kar stomata ke zariye, pani ka bukharat ban kar urna hai. Jaise pani ke bukharat patte se nikalte hain, patte ke tissue mein manfi dabao banta hai; yeh kheenchne wali quwwat pani ko jaron se tane ke raste patton ki taraf oopar kheenchti hai, is liye transpiration xylem mein pani ki naqal ki bunyadi quwwat hai.

Adhesion pani ke molecules aur xylem vessels ki deewaron ke darmiyan kashish hai. Pani ke molecules oopar jate hue deewaron se chipakte hain, jo pani ke column ko tootne se rokta aur use musalsal rakhta hai, khaas kar ooncha podon mein jahan gravity column ko zor se kheenchti hai.

Cohesion khud pani ke molecules ke darmiyan kashish ki quwwat hai, jo hydrogen bonding se hoti hai. Xylem mein pani ke molecules jaron se patton tak ek an-toota column bana kar aapas mein chipke rehte hain, is liye patte par transpiration se shuru hui kheench poore column tak pohnchti hai.

Tension patte par transpiration ki kheench se bana manfi dabao hai. Jaise pani patte ki satah se urta hai, kam dabao ka ilaqa xylem mein phailta hai, aur yeh tension cohesive pani ke column ko oopar kheenchti hai; pani ke musalsal chirhne ke liye yeh nihayat aham hai.

blocks.alt: Ek xylem vessel neeche jaron se oopar patte tak lambi nali ke taur par. Neele pani ke molecules nali mein oopar tak nuqtedar zanjeer banate hain, jahan woh deewaron ko chhoote hain wahan narangi nishan; us ke saath ek khakistari teer oopar ki taraf; neele teer jaron mein pani ka dakhla aur patte se bukharat ka nikalna dikhate hain. TACT ke chaar hisse daen label hain.
blocks.caption: Jar se patte tak pani ke bahao ka TACT mechanism (Figure 8.9 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Stomata se transpiration patte mein manfi dabao paida karti hai. Adhesion pani ko xylem ki deewaron se jore rakhti hai taake column na toote; hydrogen bonds se cohesion pani ke molecules ko ek an-toote column mein jorti hai; aur us column se neeche muntaqil hone wali tension pani ko gravity ke khilaf jaron se oopar kheenchti hai, jahan woh osmosis se root hairs mein dakhil hua tha.

blocks.prompt: Ek darakht ke patton par aisa madda chhirka jata hai jo stomata band kar deta hai. TACT ki madad se batayein ke us ke xylem mein pani ke bahao ka kya hota hai.
blocks.explanation: Band stomata transpiration rok dete hain, to na bukharat nikalte hain aur na patte mein manfi dabao banta hai. Us tension ke baghair cohesive pani ke column ko oopar kheenchne wali koi cheez nahin; adhesion aur cohesion column ko salamat magar sakin rakhte hain, is liye xylem se pani ka oopar bahao bari had tak ruk jata hai.

items: Root hairs pani aur minerals lete hain; jar ke paar yeh apoplast (cell walls, endodermis par Casparian strip se band), symplast (plasmodesmata se cytoplasm) ya na-honay ke barabar vacuolar raste se jate hain.

Xylem: tracheids (nokeele, bordered pits), vessels (perforation plates ke saath sira-ba-sira), fibres (lignin wale, murda, sahara) aur parenchyma (zinda, zakheera, pehlu ki harkat, marammat). Banawati tissue bhi hai.
TACT: transpiration tension banati hai; deewaron se adhesion aur molecules ke darmiyan cohesion ek an-toota column rakhte hain jise tension jar se patte tak oopar kheenchti hai.
